name: Fengzhushou Co., Ltd.
summary: Fengzhushou Co., Ltd. provides comprehensive operation service of digital goods in China. The company provides comprehensive operation services such as the operation and distribution of digital virtual goods rights for mobile internet-related customers; comprehensive solutions such as IoT traffic access, and hardware solutions and applications; and cloud services including cloud terminal technical services and cloud terminal software products. It also offers customized operation support services and technical services.
